markets.rules_primary: If Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture is the first Millennium Prize Problem solved after Issuance, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A Millennium Prize Problem is considered Solved at the earliest time that any of the following occurs:

A complete proof, disproof, or counterexample addressing the problem as officially formulated is published in a peer-reviewed journal.
The Clay Mathematics Institute or another recognized authoritative academic body officially recognizes in writing that the problem has been resolved by reference to a specific written work.
At least two Source Agencies report that the problem has been proven, disproven, or otherwise resolved by reference to a specific publicly available written work.
